Central bank monetary policy divergence drives forex markets as traders weigh which central bank will tighten more aggressively , with three major central banks meeting within an eight-day window in mid-September anchoring this week's risk-on environment. The Fed publishes employment data Tuesday and inflation Friday, with stronger readings pushing rate hike expectations higher , making this the critical catalyst for USD directional bias ahead of September 18 FOMC decision. USD/JPY fell sharply with downside bias toward 154.76/155.01 support , presenting the most tradeable technicals as BOJ rate hike odds rise with firming inflation signaling policy normalization . BOJ intervention capped USD/JPY near 160 after sharp moves from 164, though effectiveness remains questionable as technical levels reassert resistance .
